name: EQUAL_SECOND_MOMENT_QUARTIC_PROFILE_SPLITTING
model_basis: Trusted developer designation and full-history inherited model; no switch or runtime performance measurement.

premises.P31-PROFILES: Two fixed nonnegative symmetric Borel probabilities on [-1,1], independent of delta,W,center,branch, with equal mu2; atomic profiles allowed.
premises.P31-GEOMETRY: Identical center interval [a+delta,b-delta], actual W held fixed, V=W-mu2*delta^2, exact common two-center laws and feasibility as PHYS30.
premises.P31-C3: Inherited k in C3([a,b]) with continuous one-sided endpoint derivatives; no new recertification of this premise.
premises.P31-C4: Additional k in C4([a,b]), including continuous physical one-sided endpoint derivatives. Actual source-formula verification belongs to another contributor.
premises.P31-CONVEXITY: Inherited k''>0; min k'' on compact support is a positive abstract bound. Inherited k'''<0 supports common-profile envelope interpretation.
premises.P31-LEVEL: Exact same branch-specific level A=F(0,w), w in (0,LH); A=0 only if an exact root is assumed. Stored finite-point nonzero A is retained with arithmetic uncertainty distinguished.
premises.P31-AC-PAIR: h_u=1/2 and h_P4=(35*z^4-30*z^2+11)/16 on [-1,1], zero outside; comparison is P4 minus uniform.
premises.P31-C3-COUNTEREXAMPLE: Analytic family k=K*(Lambda*t^2-t^3+epsilon*t^p-B), t=(E-a)/E0, 3<p<4, Lambda>3T, 0<epsilon<6/[p(p-1)(p-2)T^(p-3)], constant B chosen for a fixed same level.
premises.P31-DEGENERATE-COUNTEREXAMPLE: Smooth k=K2*X^2-K3*X^3+gamma*(X^6-15*w*X^4)-B, X=E-m, K2>3*K3*max(L,H), K3>0, sufficiently small nonzero gamma and branch same-level w.
premises.P31-EXACT-TOYS: Dimensionless support[-2,2],m0,R2,w1,s=+-1; k3=1+X^2-X^3/10 and k4=k3+X^4/100; exact branch-specific A retained.
premises.P31-UNITS: E,delta,c eV; W,V eV^2; k,F,A s^-4; b3 eV^-1; b4 eV^-2. Metric(-,+,+,+), proper seconds, fixed source-real normalization; no new natural-unit choice.

claims.claim: Equal mu2 makes V=W-mu2*delta^2 and the center interval, feasibility interval, positions, probabilities and response denominator exactly common for every permitted (delta,W).
limits: Identical prescribed center interval and actual W convention; no profile-dependent narrowing or widening.

claims.claim: For k in C3([a,b]), equal-mu2 symmetric profiles have averaged-kernel difference o(delta^3), uniformly over all permitted centers, with explicit modulus-of-continuity remainder.
limits: Right physical width only; general Borel measures including atoms.
The symbolic modulus bound is not a computed numerical Taylor bound or certified width.

claims.claim: At zero width all response partial derivatives of total order at most3 are common for equal-mu2 profiles. The explicit third derivative includes moving-center terms and need not vanish.
limits: Equality of two profiles does not imply an even individual width expansion.
Every W derivative is at fixed actual variance coordinates.

claims.claim: An exact interior same-level point with positive F_W has a unique physical right-Cn root for n=3 or4 under the corresponding kernel regularity, with an actual Peano expansion.
limits: Exact zero-level existence remains a conditional premise.
No negative physical width, out-of-support kernel extension, numerical root enclosure or certified width.

claims.claim: The common cubic coefficient is the explicit implicit-derivative expression in T31.25; equal-mu2 same-level roots share c,d,b3 and differ by o(delta^3).
limits: No numerical physical b3 value or new k''' evaluation is supplied by this contribution.

claims.claim: Under C4, the profile response difference is Delta_mu4*H4*delta^4/24+o(delta^4), with H4=p*k''''(e)+q*k''''(x); the only differing fourth-total-order partial is delta^4.

limits: First possible integer order is distinct from first actual nonzero order.

limits: Stored finite arithmetic A is not overwritten by zero or taken as an exact root certificate.

Thus no fixed positive power beyond delta^3, in particular O(delta^4), follows from C3 alone.
